::: {#sol-door-run}

The sequence starts with closed,
and each later condition is $\delta$ of the condition before it and the action:

$$
\ba
\delta(\text{closed}, \mathtt{l}) &= \text{locked},
\\
\delta(\text{locked}, \mathtt{o}) &= \text{locked},
\\
\delta(\text{locked}, \mathtt{u}) &= \text{closed},
\\
\delta(\text{closed}, \mathtt{o}) &= \text{open},
\\
\delta(\text{open}, \mathtt{l}) &= \text{open}.
\ea
$$

So the sequence is

$$
\text{closed}, \text{locked}, \text{locked}, \text{closed}, \text{open}, \text{open}:
$$

six conditions for five actions.
In @fig-door, they are the states met by following, from closed, the arrows labeled $\mathtt{l}$, $\mathtt{o}$, $\mathtt{u}$, $\mathtt{o}$ and $\mathtt{l}$ in turn.

:::
